meta_title: Usage4Claude: Claude and Codex usage in your Mac menu bar
meta_description: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that tracks your Claude and Codex subscription limits: 5-hour, weekly and extra usage, with reset times and notifications.
hero_title: Your Claude and Codex limits, always in view.
hero_subtitle: A small macOS menu bar app that shows how much of your 5-hour and weekly limits you have used, and when they reset.
hero_meta: Free and open source · macOS 13 or later · Intel and Apple silicon
hero_image_alt: Usage4Claude in the menu bar: a ring view for Claude, and a pace view with Claude and Codex side by side
highlights_title: Made to be read at a glance
highlights_subtitle: One look at the menu bar tells you where you stand.
pace_title: Know whether you are on pace
pace_body: The pace graph plots each limit against the time that has passed in its window. The dotted diagonal is an even rate: above it you are using faster than the clock, below it you have room to spare. Weekly limits can count weekdays only. Prefer a simple ring? Switch any time.
pace_figure_label: Pace graph: usage against elapsed time, with a diagonal for even consumption
bar_body: Each limit has its own shape, and its color deepens as usage climbs. Show a percentage, an icon, or both, in the size that suits your menu bar.
bar_mono_caption: In the monochrome theme the shapes carry the meaning, and the icons follow a light or dark menu bar.
bar_mono_light_alt: Monochrome icons on a light menu bar
bar_mono_dark_alt: Monochrome icons on a dark menu bar
feature_apps_body: claude.ai, Claude Code, the desktop and mobile apps and Cowork all draw from the same limits. The menu bar shows the total.
feature_codex_body: Add a Codex account to follow Codex CLI, the IDE extension and Codex web next to Claude. Without one, Codex never shows up.
feature_notify_body: A macOS notification when usage crosses the levels you choose, and another when a limit resets.
feature_refresh_body: Checks often while usage is moving and slows down when it is idle, so the numbers stay current without flooding the servers.
feature_accounts_body: Sign in through your browser with Google, SSO or a passkey. Add Claude and Codex accounts, name them, and switch from the menu bar.
feature_languages_body: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, French and German. It follows your system language, or pick one.
privacy_title: Your data stays on your Mac
privacy_subtitle: No account with us, no server of ours, nothing to phone home to.
privacy_network_body: The app only talks to Claude and Codex, to GitHub to check for updates, and to codex-reset.com for the optional Codex reset announcement.
privacy_keychain_body: Session keys and tokens are kept in the macOS Keychain, never in plain text, and usage responses are never cached to disk.
privacy_sandbox_body: It runs inside the macOS App Sandbox with only the access it needs to sign in, fetch usage and install updates.
privacy_source_body: Every line is on GitHub under the MIT license, open for anyone to read and audit.
download_requirements: macOS 13 Ventura or later, on Intel or Apple silicon.
step_install_body: Open the downloaded .dmg and drag Usage4Claude into Applications.
step_gatekeeper_body: The app is not notarized by Apple, so macOS asks once. On macOS 15 or later, open it, click Done, then choose Open Anyway in System Settings → Privacy & Security. On macOS 14 or earlier, Control-click the app and choose Open.
step_signin_body: Sign in to Claude or Codex in your browser. When the Keychain asks for access, choose Always Allow.
download_note: Works with Claude Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise; Free plans have no usage data to read. New versions install from inside the app.
download_guide_link: Full guide and FAQ on GitHub
footer_tagline: Claude and Codex usage in your Mac menu bar.
